buildCommand: node -e "console.log('caniuse-lite:',require('caniuse-lite/package.json').version); console.log('resolved:',require.resolve('caniuse-lite/package.json'))" && npm ls caniuse-lite --all || true; env -u npm_config_cache_dir npm run build:css
installCommand: env -u npm_config_cache_dir npm install --force --no-audit --no-fund && env -u npm_config_cache_dir npm update caniuse-lite --force --no-save --no-audit --no-fund
